question: Identify the antonym of "Docile"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Headstrong**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Docile"** means someone who is easily managed, controlled, or taught; submissive and obedient. (आज्ञाकारी)
 
 
• **Example:** The docile dog followed its owner's commands without hesitation.
 
 
• **"Headstrong"** refers to someone who is very determined to do what they want, even if it is unreasonable or contradictory to advice or instructions. (हठी)
